​​​​​​​​The mission of the ITU Oversight Unit (OU) is to provide independent and objective audit, investigation, and evaluation services to add value, enhance ITU's operations, and strengthen the organization's integrity and reputation. Acting independently, the OU supports the ITU Secretary-General in fulfilling oversight, management, and integrity responsibilities, ensuring ITU's commitment to transparency, accountability, and high standards across all its activities.  

The main responsibilities of the OU are laid down in the Internal Oversight Charter (SO 24/09 [EN] [FR​]) as follows

​​​

Internal Audit & Advisory Services
​

​Investigations
​

Evaluations​
​​ ​

Contacts 

General questions 

  • ​ General questions or comments concerning the OU may be addressed to: ITU.OversightUnit@itu.int.  
  • Report fraud, corruption, or misconduct (excluding retaliation) to the ITU Oversight Unit at: ituhotline@proton.me. 
  • For retaliation, contact the ITU Ethics Office via: HelplineITU@protonmail.com or EthicsOffice@itu.int for advice on ethical concerns.​
